steps.summary: Loukas variation_neighborhoods coarsenings for 3 (dataset, r) settings, supplying the coarse topology GOREN relearns weights on
steps.notes: r is the fraction of nodes REMOVED. Baseline edge weights are A_c = C A C^T; GOREN replaces these in step 02. Cora and Citeseer are disconnected, so the variation cost divides by (nc-1) and emits divide-by-zero warnings on singleton subgraphs; the coarsening is unaffected and hits its target ratio.

steps.summary: Built 7 GOREN black boxes: bl and goren edge weights across 3 ratios plus no-coarsening controls
steps.notes: No published accuracy exists for GOREN on any dataset -- the paper evaluates only spectrally -- so this stage reports rather than gates. bl and goren differ in exactly one vector, the coarse edge weights. Classifier is the UGC benchmark's, which already consumes edge weights.

steps.summary: Trained GOREN's GIN for 3 settings; 3/6 improved Eigenerror, mean -126.8%
steps.notes: Loss follows the authors' loss_util.quaratic_loss: diagonal only, bottom-k eigenvectors, rayleigh-normalised, 1/|s| projection.

steps.summary: Trained the adversary's reference model g for 1 datasets and built 7 attack datasets on ORIGINAL edges
steps.notes: g mirrors the target's hyperparameters but is graph-free and runs on the original features. The adversary cannot tell a bl box from a goren box. Pair seed 1 matches the GCond, FGC and UGC benchmarks, so all four attack identical pairs.
